name: Clow Studio — Launch HQ
description: Product Hunt launch community for clow.studio — PicoClaw (private dev assistant) and OpenClaw (community AI). Built for hunters, early users, maintainers, and investors.

channels.name: launch-day
channels.topic: Live Product Hunt updates. Upvote ❯ https://www.producthunt.com — follow for rank pings.

channels.name: upvote-and-review
channels.topic: Drop your PH handle, say hi, leave a review — we'll shout you out in #thanks.

channels.name: launch-chat
channels.topic: Hype, hot-takes, and launch-day energy. No spam, no self-promo outside the pinned thread.

channels.name: thanks
channels.topic: Founders personally thank every upvoter. Shout-outs live here.

channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: First stop. Grab a role in #roles, then introduce yourself in #introductions.

channels.name: rules
channels.topic: Code of conduct. Be kind. Ship things. Disagree in public, debate in good faith.

channels.name: roles
channels.topic: React to pick: 🚀 Hunter · 🧪 Early User · 💰 Investor · 🛠 Contributor.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Official product updates. Follow to crosspost to your own server.

channels.name: roadmap
channels.topic: Public roadmap. Vote with reactions. Comment in threads.

channels.name: changelog
channels.topic: Ship notes for PicoClaw and OpenClaw. Latest first.

channels.name: picoclaw
channels.topic: PicoClaw — private dev assistant. /ask /code /debug /review /devflow /status

channels.name: openclaw
channels.topic: OpenClaw — community AI. /chat /research /compare /learn /help

channels.name: bot-playground
channels.topic: Try commands. Compare answers. Break things gently.

channels.name: bot-feedback
channels.topic: Report issues. Suggest commands. Share prompts that worked.

channels.name: bot-status
channels.topic: Automated uptime & health. Read-only.

channels.name: introductions
channels.topic: Three lines: who you are, what you're building, what you need.

channels.name: general
channels.topic: Anything AI, dev, startup. Hot takes welcome.

channels.name: show-and-tell
channels.topic: Ship logs, demos, screenshots. One post per project.

channels.name: founder-notes
channels.topic: Behind-the-scenes from the clow.studio founders. Comment freely.

channels.name: reads
channels.topic: Links worth sharing. One-line take required.

channels.name: help
channels.topic: Stuck? Include: what you tried · error · env · versions.

channels.name: integrations
channels.topic: Hook PicoClaw / OpenClaw into your stack (Slack, Linear, GitHub, Vercel…).

channels.name: prompts
channels.topic: Prompt library. Post the prompt, the result, and the model.

channels.name: contrib
channels.topic: Issues tagged `good-first-issue`, RFCs, and open PRs.

welcome_screen.description: 🚀 Clow Studio launch HQ — PicoClaw (private dev) + OpenClaw (community AI). Hunt us on Product Hunt, break the bots, meet the makers.

automod_rules.block_message: Invites need mod approval — DM a moderator.
